dataset_title: Off-street car parks with capacity and type
description: Data collected as part of the City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE), tracking off-street parking capacity per property classified as Commercial, Residential, or Private. Only Commercial facilities are marked as public parking candidates; annual survey capacity is never written as real-time available bays.

invariants.public_candidate_rule: Only parking_type === 'Commercial' is marked as is_public_candidate: true and public_access: true. Residential and Private facilities are strictly non-public (is_public_candidate: false, public_access: false).
invariants.capacity_rule: parking_spaces represents annual CLUE survey capacity, never real-time vacant spaces or sensor occupancy (is_realtime_occupancy: false, no parking observations emitted).
invariants.license_rule: License status remains review_required and access status remains candidate until formal licensing review and real crawl verification are completed.
invariants.multi_row_aggregation_rule: Upstream row granularity is establishment level without official establishment sub-keys. Multiple establishment rows sharing (census_year, property_id, parking_type) are deterministically deduplicated, sorted, and aggregated by summing parking_spaces into property-level annual capacity.

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: total_count > 0; unique (census_year, property_id, parking_type); only Commercial facilities marked as public candidates; annual capacity never written as real-time available bays
